# Command line

## Commands

### `scriptkit` { #scriptkit }

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-i, --input` | `-` | What to read. |
| `-t, --threads` | 1 | Threads. |

### `scriptkit-report` { #scriptkit-report }

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-o, --outdir` | `.` | Where to write the report. |
